p1.title: Monash这周两条 我读完了
p1.body:
11 月 12 号和 13 号 Monash 官网各发了一条，我挑出来整理了。

一条是两名本科生拿到 $45,000 奖学金，一条是器官衰老的新研究。

下面一张图一条，数字都对着官网原文。

p2.title: 两名本科生各拿4.5万澳币
p2.body:
11 月 12 号 Monash 官网：Lara Abboud 和 Jesse Wrobel 获得 Order of Australia Association Foundation Scholarship。

官方原文：They are among six undergraduate second-year award students recipients chosen from across Australian universities, with each student receiving $45,000 in financial support, as well as mentorship from a member of the Order of Australia.

新闻里写的评选看点是学业成绩加社区贡献。

申请资格新闻里没写，想申请的同学去基金会官网核对 📌
p2.tags: #莫纳什大学 #Monash #澳洲留学 #留学日常 #澳洲大学

p3.title: 他们读什么专业
p3.body:
Lara 读的是 Bachelor of Education (Honours) 中学教育，加 Bachelor of Arts 历史专业。

Jesse 读的是 Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) 加 Bachelor of Commerce。

两个人都有很多社区志愿经历，我看完觉得课外这块真的要早点积累。
p3.tags: #莫纳什大学 #Monash #澳洲留学 #留学日常 #澳洲大学

p4.title: 一种蛋白和器官衰老有关
p4.body:
11 月 13 号 Monash 官网的研究，发表在 Immunity 期刊。

官方原文：Published in Immunity, the research discovered a link between the protein Granzyme K and signs of ageing in the heart, liver and kidneys.

研究用的是小鼠模型，没有这种蛋白的老年小鼠器官衰老迹象更少。

读生物医学的同学可以去看原文 🔬

mp.title: 两名 Monash 本科生各获 $45,000 奖学金；研究发现一种蛋白推动器官衰老
mp.lead: 11 月 12 日和 13 日，莫纳什大学官网发布两条消息：两名本科生获得 Order of Australia Association Foundation Scholarship；Monash Biomedicine Discovery Institute 发现 Granzyme K 与器官衰老损伤有关。下面逐条拆，原文都对着官网核过。

newsBodies.h2: 01 OAAF 奖学金：两名 Monash 本科生各获 $45,000
paragraphs: 11 月 12 日，Monash 官网发布：Lara Abboud 和 Jesse Wrobel 获得 Order of Australia Association Foundation Scholarship。官方原文：They are among six undergraduate second-year award students recipients chosen from across Australian universities, with each student receiving $45,000 in financial support, as well as mentorship from a member of the Order of Australia.
官方介绍，这个奖学金 recognises academic excellence alongside extensive contribution to their community。奖项由总督 Sam Mostyn AC 在堪培拉总督府宣布。
Lara 就读 Bachelor of Education (Honours) 中学教育和 Bachelor of Arts（历史）；Jesse 就读 Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) 和 Bachelor of Commerce。新闻没有写申请资格和申请方式，具体请以基金会官网为准。

newsBodies.h2: 02 器官衰老研究：Granzyme K 与心肝肾衰老有关
paragraphs: 11 月 13 日，Monash 官网发布：Published in Immunity, the research discovered a link between the protein Granzyme K and signs of ageing in the heart, liver and kidneys.
Granzyme K 是免疫细胞产生的一种蛋白，官方原文：Granzyme K is a protein produced by immune cells, with levels known to increase significantly with age in both mice and humans.
Nicole La Gruta 教授：What's particularly exciting is that mice without this protein showed reduced signs of organ ageing, even though their immune systems continued to age normally. 研究基于临床前小鼠模型。
